_doc: Settlement build-out priority for Clan Skryre, as given by the player on 2026-10-16.
Slot 1 is always the main building, upgraded to the settlement's maximum (capital tier 5, minor tier 3).
Port settlements always hold the port chain in slot 2; it cannot be removed and is upgraded to the maximum.
Remaining slots are filled top to bottom from 'priority'. Every chain goes to the highest level the settlement allows.
If slots run out, lower entries are dropped. Leftover slots stay empty.
A chain set to null for a settlement type is not buildable there and is skipped.
per_province: at most that many of the chain per province. Capital is considered first, then minor settlements.

Order since 2026-10-20 (player decisions, Stormvermin replaced by Warp-Doom Magma-Cannons): the Warpstone Reactor (province-wide income multiplier) first, landmarks always stay, then the two buildings that recruit the army template (Equipment Warpforge, Warp-Turbine Plant), then the rest. A capital has 7 slots besides the main building (6 with a port): chains that reach tier 5 (Reactor, Temple) come before the tier-3 ones (Breeding Pit, Scrap Heap), which are the minor settlements' buildings; Chained Sentry Beasts and Spy Nests are filler and go first. Clan Armoury (Stormvermin) is off the list: a standing one is replaced when its slot is needed.

Spending (assist/build.py spend_rank, 2026-10-20): gold goes across all provinces in this order, not province by province: main building and port upgrades, the Reactor line, landmarks, the recruit buildings (capital closest to tier 5 first), then the rest in list order. Top items (any of those four) affordable within 2 turns of net income are saved for; everything else is bought with the spare gold, as long as no saved item is pushed a turn later (player decision 2026-10-20, after a 10-turn simulation: holding all the gold earned 600 from new buildings, spending the spare 1,630, with the landmark done on the same turn). The army step leaves only what the saved items still need.
What a capital lets go: no port: Spy Nests; one landmark or a port: Sentry Beasts and Spy Nests; port + landmark: also the Scrap Heap; port + 2 landmarks: also the Breeding Pit.

priority.name: Warpstone Reactor
priority._why: +30/40/50% income from every building in the province (all its settlements), paid back in about 6 turns; first in the list and first in spending after main building upgrades (player decision 2026-10-20).

priority.name: Landmarks
priority._skip: Landmarks never planned (player rule 2026-10-18): the Morskittar Engine (Zhufbar) is single player only, locked by Thanquol's story until mission 5 and locked out in multiplayer; its slot takes the next building on the list.

priority.name: Equipment Warpforge
priority._why: Recruits the Stormfiends (Ratling Cannons) of the army template. Tier 5: capitals only.

priority.name: Warp-Turbine Plant
priority._why: Recruits the Warp-Doom Magma-Cannons of the army template (2026-10-20); its Construction Cavern level also recruits Warlock Engineers and counts for Ikit's Workshop level 2. Tier 5: capitals only (minor null, so a minor never gets a lone Cavern). No per_province: a province has one capital, and per_province would let an old Cavern in a minor claim the chain and keep it out of the capital.

priority.name: Resource buildings
priority._why: A resource building already standing (mine, quarry, ...) is kept at its level, never demolished for the entries below it (player decision 2026-10-20, by value: Zhufbar's Iron Mining Pit makes +80 and iron for nothing; replacing it with Chained Sentry Beasts costs 2,000 gold for +100, and demolishing refunds only 60% of 250). Not upgraded: +10 income for 500-1,000 gold.

priority.name: Overseer's Lookout
priority._why: The order chain in minor settlements (tier 3 there), after the Breeding Pit and Scrap Heap as before 2026-10-20.
